School Life

School is more than lessons. It is friendship, celebrations, new skills and the feeling of belonging to a family.

A typical day

A day at Asylkech

  1. 08:00

    Morning welcome

    Girls are met at the door by their teachers.

  2. 08:30

    Lessons begin

    Core subjects while minds are fresh.

  3. 12:30

    Lunch and rest

    Time to eat together and talk with friends.

  4. 14:00

    Clubs and study

    Clubs, sports and supervised homework.

  5. 16:30

    Home time

    Parents collect their daughters from school.

Times are indicative and may differ by grade.

Clubs

  • Robotics & coding

  • Choir & komuz

  • Reading club

Traditions

Moments we celebrate together

Knowledge Day

The first bell of the school year on 1 September.

Teachers’ Day

Concerts and gratitude for our teachers.

New Year concert

Performances, decorations and family guests.

International Women’s Day

A special day in a school full of girls, on 8 March.

Nooruz

Sumolok, national costumes and spring celebrations on 21 March.

Last Bell & graduation

Farewell to our graduates at the end of May.

Wellbeing

Care for every girl

Class teacher

A trusted adult who follows each girl’s progress and wellbeing.

School psychologist

Support with emotions, friendships and exam stress.

Medical office

A nurse on site during the school day.

Partnership with parents

Regular meetings and open communication with families.
